Ninguém consegue entender por completo as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} decisões. Ninguém consegue seguir os caminhos por onde {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} anda.

am.L: ኦ የእግዚአብሔር የብልጽግናና የጥበብ የእውቀትም ጥልቀት! ፍርዶቹ እንዴት የማይመረመሩ፣ መንገዶቹም እንዴት የማይደረስባቸው [ናቸው]!
am.B: የእግዚአብሔር ብልጽግና፣ ጥበብና እውቀት እንዴት ጥልቅ ነው! ፍርዶቹን መመርመር፣ መንገዶቹንም መከታተል እንዴት የማይቻል ነው!
am.R: የእግዚአብሔር ብልጽግና እንዴት ታላቅ ነው! ጥበቡና እውቀቱ እንዴት ጥልቅ ነው! ውሳኔዎቹን ማንም ሙሉ በሙሉ ሊረዳ አይችልም። የሚሄድባቸውንም መንገዶች ማንም ሊከታተል አይችልም።

ru.L: О глубина богатства, и мудрости, и знания Божьего! Как неисследимы {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} суды и пути {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} не выследить!
ru.B: Как глубоки богатство, мудрость и знание Бога! Невозможно исследовать {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} решения, невозможно проследить {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} пути!
ru.R: Как велико Божье богатство! Как глубоки {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} мудрость и знание! Никто не может до конца понять {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} решения. Никто не может проследить, какими путями {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} идёт.

hi.L: अहा, परमेश्वर का धन और बुद्धि और ज्ञान कितना गहरा है! उनके निर्णय कैसे अगम और उनके मार्ग कैसे अथाह हैं!
hi.B: परमेश्वर का धन और उनकी बुद्धि और उनका ज्ञान कितना गहरा है! उनके निर्णयों की थाह कोई नहीं ले सकता, और उनके मार्गों का पता कोई नहीं लगा सकता!
hi.R: परमेश्वर का धन कितना बड़ा है! उनकी बुद्धि और उनका ज्ञान कितना गहरा है! उनके फ़ैसलों को कोई पूरी तरह नहीं समझ सकता। वे जिन रास्तों पर चलते हैं, उनका पीछा कोई नहीं कर सकता।

uk.L: О глибино багатства, і мудрості, і пізнання Бога! Які неможливо дослідити {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} присуди, і неможливо вистежити {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} шляхи!
uk.B: Яке глибоке багатство, і мудрість, і пізнання Бога! Неможливо збагнути {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} присудів, і неможливо простежити {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} шляхів!
uk.R: Яке велике Боже багатство! Яка глибока {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} мудрість і {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} знання! Ніхто не може повністю зрозуміти {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} рішень. Ніхто не може простежити шляхів, якими {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} іде.

ja.L: ああ、神の富と知恵と知識の深さよ！その定めはなんと調べ尽くしがたく、その道はなんとたどりがたいことでしょう！
ja.B: 神の富と知恵と知識は、なんと深いのでしょう！神の定めはだれにも調べ尽くすことができず、神の道はだれにもたどることができません！
ja.R: 神の豊かさは、なんと大きいのでしょう！神の知恵と知識は、なんと深いのでしょう！神が決められることを、だれも完全には理解できません。神の進まれる道を、だれもたどることはできません。

decisions.choice: three things are deep: God's riches, God's wisdom and God's knowledge
alternatives: the depth of the riches of God's wisdom and knowledge
decisions.reason: The three nouns are joined by "and ... and", so most likely each is its own subject of praise. The riches would be the riches of God's mercy (2:4, 9:23, 10:12). The other reading takes riches as describing the wisdom and knowledge.
The word here means the decisions God makes in governing the world and history, as the chapter has described them.
Paul's praise echoes the Old Testament theme that no one can search out the depths of God (Job 11:7-8) or match his thoughts and ways (Isaiah 55:8-9).

decisions.choice: No one can trace the paths he takes
decisions.reason: Readable turns the adjective into a plain sentence; the word means a track that cannot be followed.
Paul's praise stays in the letter's 합쇼체; "-도다" is archaic and "-지요" belongs to 해요체.
The judgments are God's decisions (meaning decision), not his judgment of sinners, so "심판" (2:2-5) is not used.

decisions.choice: "sâu thẳm" said of all three nouns (L, B)
alternatives: "sự giàu có của sự khôn ngoan"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads three things as deep: riches, wisdom and knowledge, with a footnote for "riches of wisdom and knowledge". Vietnamese lists the three nouns side by side so that "sâu thẳm" governs each. "Tri thức" is the word kept for knowledge in 2:20.

decisions.choice: impossíveis de sondar ... de rastrear (L); Ninguém consegue investigar ... seguir o rastro (B)
decisions.reason: The two adjectives are rare learned words in Portuguese; Literal and Balanced say what they mean (a depth no one can search, a track no one can follow), as the English does, and keep clear of the familiar wording of other versions.

decisions.choice: የብልጽግናና የጥበብ የእውቀትም ጥልቀት (L); ብልጽግና፣ ጥበብና እውቀት (B)
alternatives: the familiar 1962 wording of this verse
decisions.reason: The verse is well known in an older wording; it is drafted afresh from the Greek, with ብልጽግና for 'riches' as in 11:12, and the three things that are deep kept apart (meaning note m1).

decisions.choice: "定め" (L, B); "神が決められること" (R)
decisions.reason: The word here means the decisions God makes in governing history (m2). "裁き" would suggest condemnation; "定め" is what God has decided.

source.text: Τίς γὰρ ἔγνω νοῦν κυρίου;

ru.B: Ведь «кто знает мысли Господа?»
ru.R: Как говорит Писание: «Кто когда-нибудь знал, что думает Господь?»

hi.L: क्योंकि "प्रभु के मन को किसने जाना है?"
hi.B: क्योंकि "प्रभु के मन को किसने जाना है?"
hi.R: जैसा पवित्रशास्त्र कहता है, "प्रभु क्या सोचते हैं, यह कौन कभी जान पाया है?"

ja.R: 聖書にこう書いてあります。「主の考えを、いったいだれが知っていただろうか？」

decisions.reason: Paul quotes the old Greek translation of Isaiah 40:13, as he does in 1 Corinthians 2:16. The Hebrew reads "Who has measured the Spirit of the LORD?", with the divine name; the Greek has "Lord". The quotation continues in the next sentence.
The question means that no one knows God's plans unless he reveals them.
Readable tells the reader that a quotation follows, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: "주" (L); "주님" (B, R), with no divine_name span; the quotation in 해라체
decisions.reason: The Greek has kyrios, as in the quotations at 9:28 and 10:13; Scripture is quoted in 해라체 through the letter.
Isaiah has the divine name, but the Greek quotation has "Lord". As in 9:28 and 10:13, the New Testament wording is followed with "Chúa".

ja.B: 「あるいは、だれが主の相談相手であっただろうか？」

decisions.reason: This is the second line of Isaiah 40:13; the Hebrew asks who has instructed the LORD as his counselor.
Readable uses a plain verb.

decisions.choice: "主" for the pronoun "his" (L, B, R); "神" for "him" in verse 35 (R)
decisions.reason: Japanese does not use 彼 for God, and a bare pronoun would be unclear, so the questions name the Lord of the line before. Literal does not bracket it, since it renders the Greek pronoun rather than adding a word.

vi.R: "Có ai từng tặng Đức Chúa Trời một món quà, để Đức Chúa Trời phải đền đáp lại cho họ không?"

pt.B: "Ou quem {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} deu alguma coisa primeiro, para ter de ser pago de volta?"
pt.R: "Alguém já deu um presente a Deus, para que Deus tenha de lhe pagar de volta?"

am.L: «ወይስ አስቀድሞ ለእርሱ የሰጠና ብድራት የሚመለስለት ማን ነው?»
am.B: «ወይስ አስቀድሞ አንዳች ሰጥቶት ብድሩ የሚከፈለው ማን ነው?»
am.R: «እግዚአብሔር መልሶ እንዲከፍለው ለእግዚአብሔር ስጦታ የሰጠ ማን አለ?»

ru.L: «Или кто прежде дал {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}, и ему будет воздано?»
ru.B: «Или кто первым дал {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} что-нибудь, так что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} должен вернуть долг?»
ru.R: «Кто-нибудь когда-нибудь дарил Богу подарок, чтобы Бог был обязан отплатить ему?»

hi.L: "या किसने पहले उन्हें कुछ दिया है, कि उसे उसका बदला दिया जाए?"
hi.B: "या किसने उन्हें पहले कुछ दिया है कि उसे बदले में चुकाया जाए?"
hi.R: "क्या किसी ने कभी परमेश्वर को कोई भेंट दी है, कि परमेश्वर को उसे बदले में कुछ चुकाना पड़े?"

uk.L: «Або хто наперед дав {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}, і йому буде віддано?»
uk.B: «Або хто дав {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}} щось першим, щоб {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} мусив віддавати?»
uk.R: «Чи хтось колись дав Богові дарунок, щоб Бог мусив йому віддати?»

ja.L: 「あるいは、だれが先に主に与えて、その人に報いが返されるだろうか？」
ja.B: 「あるいは、だれがまず主に何かを与えて、お返しを受けて当然だろうか？」
ja.R: 「神に先に贈り物をして、神からお返しを受けるはずの人がいるだろうか？」

decisions.reason: The words are close to the Hebrew of Job 41:11 (41:3 in Hebrew), where God says, "Who has first given to me, that I should repay him?" The old Greek translation of that verse is quite different. In Job the divine name is not in this line.

decisions.choice: a question that expects the answer "no one"
decisions.reason: God owes nothing to anyone; everything he gives is grace (4:4, 11:6).

decisions.choice: God ... God must pay them back
alternatives: him ... it will be repaid to him
decisions.reason: Readable names God for both pronouns. The giver is "them", an English pronoun for one person of either sex.

decisions.choice: "그분께" with the honorific for God; "그" (L) for the giver
decisions.reason: In this quotation the speaker is not God, so God is spoken of with the honorific as in the letter; the human giver takes the plain "그".

alternatives: deu a ele ... será retribuído a ele
decisions.reason: Both clauses have "to him", but only the first is God; the second is the giver, so only the first "lhe" takes the deity_pronoun span, as in the English.

source.text: ὅτι ἐξ αὐτοῦ καὶ δι’ αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰς αὐτὸν τὰ πάντα· αὐτῷ ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας, ἀμήν.

records.literal_gloss: Because from him and through him and to him the all things; to him the glory to the ages, amen.

en.L: For from {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and through {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} [are] all things. To {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} [be] the glory forever. Amen.
en.B: For all things are from {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and through {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. To {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} be glory forever! Amen.
en.R: Everything comes from {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. Everything exists through {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. Let all glory be {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} forever! Amen.

es.L: Porque de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} y por medio de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} y hacia {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} [son] todas las cosas. A {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} [sea] la gloria por los siglos. Amén.
es.B: Porque todas las cosas son de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, por medio de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} y para {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. ¡A {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} la gloria para siempre! Amén.
es.R: Todo viene de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Todo existe por medio de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} y para {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. ¡Que toda la gloria sea {{deity_pronoun:suya|Suya}} para siempre! Amén.

sw.L: Kwa maana kutoka {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}, na kupitia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}, na kuelekea {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} [ni] vitu vyote. Kwake [uwe] utukufu hata milele. Amina.
sw.B: Kwa maana vitu vyote vimetoka {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}, vipo kupitia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}, na ni kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Utukufu uwe {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} milele! Amina.
sw.R: Kila kitu kinatoka {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}. Kila kitu kipo kupitia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} na kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Utukufu wote na uwe {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} milele! Amina.

fr.L: Car de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, et par {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, et pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} [sont] toutes choses. À {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} la gloire pour les siècles. Amen.
fr.B: Car tout est de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, par {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} et pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. À {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} soit la gloire éternellement ! Amen.
fr.R: Tout vient de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Tout existe par {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} et pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Que toute la gloire {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} revienne pour toujours ! Amen.

ko.L: 만물이 그분에게서 [나오고], 그분을 통하여 [있고], 그분께로 [돌아가기] 때문입니다. 그분께 영광이 영원히 [있기를 바랍니다]. 아멘.
ko.B: 모든 것이 그분에게서 나오고, 그분을 통해 있고, 그분을 위해 있기 때문입니다. 그분께 영원히 영광이 있기를 빕니다! 아멘.
ko.R: 모든 것이 그분에게서 나옵니다. 모든 것이 그분을 통해, 그리고 그분을 위해 있습니다. 모든 영광이 영원히 그분께 있기를 빕니다! 아멘.

vi.L: Vì từ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, bởi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và hướng về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] muôn vật. Nguyện vinh quang [thuộc về] {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đời đời! A-men.
vi.B: Vì muôn vật đều từ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, qua {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Nguyện vinh quang thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đời đời! A-men.
vi.R: Mọi vật đến từ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Mọi vật có được là nhờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Nguyện mọi vinh quang thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đời đời! A-men.

pt.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}, e por meio {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}, e para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} [são] todas as coisas. A {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} a glória para sempre. Amém.
pt.B: Pois todas as coisas vêm {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}, existem por meio {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} e são para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. A {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} seja a glória para sempre! Amém.
pt.R: Tudo vem {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}. Tudo existe por meio {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} e para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. Que toda a glória seja {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} para sempre! Amém.

am.L: ምክንያቱም ሁሉም ነገር ከእርሱ፣ በእርሱ በኩል፣ ወደ እርሱም [ነው]። ክብሩ ለእርሱ እስከ ዘመናት [ይሁን]። አሜን።
am.B: ሁሉም ነገር ከእርሱ የተገኘ፣ በእርሱ በኩል የሆነና ለእርሱ የሆነ ነውና። ክብር ለዘላለም ለእርሱ ይሁን! አሜን።
am.R: ሁሉም ነገር የሚመጣው ከእርሱ ነው። ሁሉም ነገር የሚኖረው በእርሱና ለእርሱ ነው። ክብር ሁሉ ለዘላለም የእርሱ ይሁን! አሜን።

ru.L: Ведь из {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}}, и через {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}}, и к {{deity_pronoun:нему|Нему}} всё. Ему слава вовеки. Аминь.
ru.B: Ведь всё — от {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}}, через {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}} и для {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}}. Ему слава вовеки! Аминь.
ru.R: Всё происходит от {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}}. Всё существует через {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}} и для {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}}. Пусть вся слава принадлежит {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} вечно! Аминь.

hi.L: क्योंकि उन्हीं से और उन्हीं के द्वारा और उन्हीं के लिए सब कुछ [है]। उन्हीं की महिमा युगानुयुग [हो]। आमीन।
hi.B: क्योंकि सब कुछ उन्हीं से, उन्हीं के द्वारा और उन्हीं के लिए है। उनकी महिमा युगानुयुग होती रहे! आमीन।
hi.R: सब कुछ उन्हीं से आता है। सब कुछ उन्हीं के द्वारा और उन्हीं के लिए बना है। सारी महिमा सदा उन्हीं की हो! आमीन।

uk.L: Бо від {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}, і через {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}, і до {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}} — усе. Йому слава навіки. Амінь.
uk.B: Бо від {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}, через {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}} і для {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}} існує все. Йому слава навіки! Амінь.
uk.R: Усе походить від {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}. Усе існує через {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}} і для {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}. Нехай уся слава буде {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} навіки! Амінь.

ja.L: なぜなら、すべてのものは、この方から、この方によって、この方に向かって[ある]からです。この方に栄光が世々にありますように。アーメン。
ja.B: すべてのものは、神から出て、神によって成り、神のためにあるのです。栄光が永遠に神にありますように！アーメン。
ja.R: すべてのものは神から出ています。すべてのものは神によって存在し、神のためにあります。すべての栄光が、いつまでも神のものでありますように！アーメン。

decisions.choice: from him, through him, to him: God is the source, the means and the goal of all things
decisions.reason: The three prepositions say that all things come from God, exist by his working, and lead back to him (compare 1 Corinthians 8:6).

decisions.choice: to him be the glory: a wish or prayer
alternatives: to him is the glory: a statement
decisions.reason: The Greek has no verb. A doxology like this is normally a prayer that God will be glorified, as in 16:27 and Galatians 1:5.
"To the ages" is a Greek way of saying "forever".
English says "for him" for the goal or purpose of something.
Readable puts the prayer in plain words, as the meaning decision describes it.
God is the source, the means and the goal of all things (meaning decision). Literal keeps the direction "to him"; Balanced and Readable say the goal with "위해", as the English does.
God is the source, the means and the goal of all things (m1). Literal keeps the direction of "to him"; Balanced and Readable say "vì Ngài" (for him), as the English does. "A-men" as in 1:25.

alternatives: todas as coisas são dele, por ele e para ele
decisions.reason: Portuguese needs a verb for each preposition to read naturally ("vêm de", "existem por meio de", "são para"); the three verbs follow the meaning decision on source, means and goal.
Literal keeps the Greek 'to the ages'; Balanced and Readable say ለዘላለም, the ordinary word for forever.

decisions.choice: "この方" (L); "神" (B, R); "世々に" (L), "永遠に" (B), "いつまでも" (R)
decisions.reason: Japanese does not use 彼 for God. Literal keeps the run of pronouns as "この方", the respectful demonstrative; Balanced and Readable name God. "To the ages" means forever (m3): Literal keeps the plural of ages with "世々".
